description: Image (PNG, JPG, WebP) to clean, editable SVG that keeps its shape and colours. Returns a link, extra files and size. Price: $0.01. Logo or icon as tiny SVG code: model amnt-vectorize-1.1, $0.08. Have no image? Use svg_generate. Needs an API key. Failed calls are free.

detail.description: low = bold, few shapes. medium = default. high = most detail.

formats.description: Extra files, free: png, pdf, eps, dxf, icons (favicon zip), small.

image.description: https URL, data: URI or base64.

include_svg.description: Include the SVG code in the reply. Default: link only.

layers.description: objects = each part (hat, face…) as its own named group. +$0.02.

mode.description: cutout = no overlapping shapes (Figma, Cricut, laser).

model.description: Default: amnt-trace-1.2 (AMNT Draw 1.2). amnt-auto picks one, $0.01–$0.25. amnt-svg-lite-1.1 $0.01: Simple icons, charts, patterns and flat backgrounds. Fastest and cheapest. · amnt-svg-1.1 $0.03: Icons, logos, lettering, NFT bases and traits, as tiny clean SVG code. · amnt-svg-pro-1.1 $0.25: Characters, mascots and detailed art. The best NFT bases. · amnt-trace-1.2 $0.05: Icons, logos, pixel art and illustrations with a few true colours. · amnt-vectorize-1.1 $0.08: Turn your picture into a clean SVG. Logos and icons come back as tiny clean code. · amnt-animate-1.1 $0.05: One prompt, a moving SVG. Every moving part is its own named group. Hand-drawn or flat.

name: svg_vectorize
title: Turn an image into SVG
